animations.name: Strong Punch Low
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start from the exact supplied low kneeling crouch guard pose. Perform ONE SINGLE explosive Cammy-style low lunging heavy strike across the clip (strictly one strike only, never twice), pure body motion only in empty air: staying very low near the ground baseline, Elisa coils tightly back, then rockets forward into a sharp low horizontal lunge with her back leg stretched behind her, driving a fast, heavy straight right forearm-and-fist smash straight right while her left arm sweeps back for balance; brief hold at full lunge, then smooth return to the starting crouch guard pose. Preserve exact face, hairstyle, denim jacket, dark pants, footwear, scale and pixel art. Keep the entire body and raised fist cleanly inside the 512x512 frame with margin on all edges. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, clean sprite only.
